newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber firm but trade featureless.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber firm but trade featureless.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were firm at midday but trade was featureless, with the usual lack of buying interest seen at the start of the week, said traders.
"It's the usual quiet Monday morning," said an official trade source.
Traders said on Friday that prices were expected to inch up on shortcovering this week, ahead of the approaching summer holidays.
At midday, June RSS 1 buyer was officially quoted at 280 cents ($1.12) a kg, up half cent from Friday's close. June SMR 20 buyer was officially unchanged at 264.
Traders quoted the SMR20 at 260, SMR CV at 328, SMR 5 at 270, SMR L at 307, SMR 10 at 261 and drum latex at 226.
